title: 第117章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这几日,韩瑶接连看望落云好几次，再三确定她是自己不愿见客,而不是哥哥强迫拘禁了她不准出府的。

从韩瑶的反应，便可以看出外面的影传有多么厉害，就连知道内情的韩瑶心里都有些画魂。

那些急着给太子生孩子的女人，一定都热切盼着她早日殁了呢！

甚至还有些等不及的，主动来看看她死了没有。

这日瑞王妃与几位夫人便来求见太子妃了。

原来中秋晚上的宫宴时，要制月饼,饼中需要放入写了各府才子才女诗句的纸条，增添趣味。这事儿原是该皇后操持，可惜宗皇后最近入了佛堂。

瑞王妃原本是京城里几个世家诗社的掌事,便拿着誊写好的诗,带着诗社里的夫人们让太子妃代为挑选入饼。

当然，这也都是借口。方锦书就是想来看看苏落云到底是怎么样了。

落云原本也可以借故推脱了,可又觉得也该让那些传谣言的歇一歇口舌了。于是看了她们的拜帖后，欣然同意,就在东宫的客厅里见一见她们。

以前落云每次见方锦书,都需要向她行礼问安。

这也是落云成为太子妃后,二人私下里第一次碰面。

只是这次,方锦书不得不屈膝向苏落云跪下，开口与她行礼问安。跪拜的时候，方锦书的脸色也是不大好看，满是国破山河在的悲怆。

落云依旧落落大方，得体地让瑞王妃免礼，又吩咐人赐座,笑吟吟地问她瑞王世子可安好。

方锦书本以为会看到个一脸病容,被软禁得有些困顿的女子样貌。

可是这苏落云却是一脸闲适从容,看上去比在茂林县的时候，更是娇艳动人。

方锦书觉得苏落云开口就问自己的儿子，是故意的！

自从上次，方锦书在自家花园里故意没有抱住襁褓里的儿子入水后，鲁国公夫妇生怕再出什么意外，压根不让她近孩子的身了。

而且那婴孩好像也有感知，知道自己不讨亲娘喜欢，加之平日都是奶娘带他，跟方锦书一点也不亲近，每次看见她就咧嘴大哭。

鲁国公思前想后，怕小世子在他的府上出了意外，便入宫禀明了太上皇，将这孩子过继到了韩家的一个宗亲的名下，代为照料。

太上皇当时一听就明白了，这是守寡的儿媳妇嫌弃累赘，要甩包袱了。

毕竟方锦书没有替瑞王守寡的意思，以后还要再嫁人的。鲁国公站在父亲的角度替女儿考量，少了个拖累总是好的。所以太上皇只是摆了摆手，任着他们去了。

落云其实还真不知道这事儿，只是随口一问，没想到正好戳在了方锦书的短处上。

她认定苏落云是在嘲讽自己，却依旧挺直腰杆垂眸道：“我父亲怜惜世子没有父亲，已经禀明了太上皇，将他过继到了皇叔允孝王爷的名下，早就不在我身边了，太子妃这么问，是怪我没有尽做母亲的义务吗？”

落云看这位瑞王妃的尖酸刻薄劲儿丝毫未减，也是微微一笑，道：“我还真不知这事儿，既然是太上皇的安排，自然是对小世子最好的了，这是瑞王妃的家事，别人如何好评判？你自己心安便好……”

看在太上皇的面子上，像瑞王遗孀这类的神仙，都是要搭板供起来的，以表示陛下对太上皇一脉照顾有佳。

不过既然是神仙，平日散养吃吃香火瓜果便好，可非要下凡来惹人，落云也绝不会姑息。

想起最近几次，韩临风无论参加什么宴会，都能巧遇这位瑞王妃，再听说瑞王妃把尚在襁褓的儿子送了人，落云便明白这位瑞王妃在打着破镜重圆的主意，也不打算跟她太多应酬。

落云看了看她们呈现上来的诗，选了些合家团圆喜庆的，便说道：“我最近身子不适，有些累了，你们若无事，便回去吧。”

可是方锦书这次来，就是有些话要对苏落云说，所以在其他夫人纷纷识趣跪安的时候，方锦书却独留下来，表示跟太子妃还有些话说。

落云慢慢饮了一口茶，看着突然跪下的方锦书道：“瑞王妃好好说话，怎么突然跪下了？”

瑞王妃跪得腰肢挺直，带着一副豁出去的神情道：“我自知以前大大得罪了太子妃您，不过您大人有大量，既然能对竣国公夫人都笑脸相迎，想必也能原谅我当初的不懂事。”

落云静看着她，没有说话。

方锦书继续开口道：“您这么多天没有出现人前，想必也领会到了这太子妃不是那么好当的。太子扶持陛下刚刚即位，须得世家鼎力扶持。可他们父子先前跟几大世家都无什么交情，急需联姻。陛下还好，宫中充盈了不少世家女子。可是太子府上却连个妾侍都没有。他为国操劳，身边怎么能少了侍奉冷暖之人？若是太子妃肯原谅了我，我愿以侍妾奴婢的身份入府，侍奉你们二位，也一定会让父亲作为方家族长，鼎力扶持太子。还请太子妃以大局为重，多替太子考量，我定然会心存感恩，尽心扶持太子妃您，不叫后来者居上。”

这个商贾出身的女子不会以为，韩临风以后也要像在梁州那样，家宅里一个妾侍都没有吧？自己这般主动投诚，就是要帮她苏落云固宠的意思。

只要这个商贾女子会算计，就应该知道如今她无依无靠，若是有方家的支持，那她在东宫的日子也会好过些。

落云知道方锦书一向做事肆无忌惮，可没想到她居然这么豁得出，竟然连作侍妾奴婢的话都能说的出来。

不过她也清楚方二的小伎俩。她乃是方家的嫡女，就算之前嫁了人，那嫁的也是堂堂皇子。这样的二嫁贵女可不是乡里寡妇改嫁，须得往下走。

那前朝的皇帝，迎娶贵族寡妇入宫为妃的比比皆是。

方锦书就算说为侍妾，若韩临风真的这么做了，便是羞辱逝去的九皇子，将太上皇的脸扔在脚下踩，就此留下轻慢的话柄。

所以落云听了方锦书的话，又是笑了笑，淡淡道：“难为九皇子的丧期不满一年，瑞王妃就要为现太子的前程如此殚精竭虑。”

先夫横死，就算做做样子，做妻子的也该守丧一年再谈改嫁。若是换了旁的女子，早就因为太子妃的嘲讽而羞愧难当了。

可方锦书向来异于常人，听了这话，依旧高昂着头，冷冷道：“斯人已逝，九皇子在天之灵若是知道我得了太子的照顾，也一定含笑九泉，可以放心离去！”

落云又喝了一口压惊茶，不然好像要看见九皇子跳动的棺材盖了。

喝了一口茶，落云觉得跟这女疯子也不必多言便道：“你可是瑞王的遗孀，就算真跟太子有些前情，他也不会纳你。你若无别的事，还请回吧……”

Page (1/3)

In the past few days, Han Yao visited Luoyun several times and made sure that she was not allowed to leave the house because she did not want to see guests and was not forced to leave the house by her brother.

From Han Yao's reaction, we can see how powerful the shadow transmission outside is. Even Han Yao, who knows the inside story, has some painting spirit in her heart.

Those women who were eager to give birth to a child for the prince must be eagerly looking forward to her early death!

Some even couldn't wait and took the initiative to see if she was dead.

On this day, Princess Rui and several ladies came to ask to see the Crown Princess.

It turns out that during the palace banquet on the night of the Mid-Autumn Festival, moon cakes were made, and notes with poems written by talented men and women from various prefectures were put into the cakes to add interest.This matter was originally handled by the queen, but unfortunately Empress Zong recently entered the Buddhist hall.

Princess Rui was originally the director of several aristocratic poetry societies in the capital, so she took the transcribed poems and took the ladies in the poetry societies to let the Crown Princess choose the cakes on her behalf.

Of course, these are all excuses.Fang Jinshu just wanted to see how Su Luoyun was doing.

Luoyun could have used an excuse to evade, but he felt that it was time to give those spreading rumors a break.So after reading their invitations, I readily agreed to meet them in the living room of the East Palace.

In the past, every time Luoyun saw Fang Jinshu, he had to salute her and say hello.

This was also the first time the two met in private after Luo Yun became the Crown Princess.

Only this time, Fang Jinshu had to kneel down to Su Luoyun and salute her.When he knelt down and worshiped, Fang Jinshu's face was not very pretty, full of sorrow that his country had been destroyed.

Luo Yun was still Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo Luo gracefully asked Princess Rui to abstain from the ceremony, then ordered someone to give her a seat, and asked her with a smile if Prince Rui, Prince Rui, was okay.

Fang Jinshu originally expected to see a woman with a sick face and a somewhat trapped appearance under house arrest.

But this Su Luoyun had a leisurely and calm look on her face, and she looked even more charming than when she was in Maolin County.

Fang Jinshu felt that Su Luoyun asked his son intentionally when he opened his mouth!

Ever since Fang Jinshu deliberately entered the water without holding her infant son in her garden last time, Lu Guogong and his wife were afraid of another accident and would not let her get close to the child at all.

Moreover, the baby seemed to have a sense that he was not liked by his mother. In addition, the nanny usually took care of him, and he was not close to Fang Jinshu at all. Every time he saw her, he would grin and cry.

Duke Lu Guo thought about it and feared that something might happen to the young prince in his house, so he went to the palace to inform the emperor and adopted the child into the name of a relative of the Han family to take care of him.

The Emperor understood immediately upon hearing this that the widowed daughter-in-law disliked the burden and wanted to get rid of the burden.

After all, Fang Jinshu had no intention of becoming a widow for King Rui and would marry again in the future.Duke Lu considered his daughter from the father's point of view. It would be good to have one less burden.So the Supreme Emperor just waved his hand and let them go.

Luoyun actually didn't know about this, so he just asked casually, but he didn't expect that it hit Fang Jinshu's shortcomings.

She believed that Su Luoyun was mocking her, but she still straightened her back and lowered her eyes and said: "My father pitied the prince for not having a father. He has already informed the Supreme Emperor and adopted him under the name of his uncle, Prince Yunxiao. He is no longer with me. The Crown Princess asked this, is it because I have not fulfilled my obligation as a mother?"

Seeing that Princess Rui's vitriol had not diminished at all, Luo Yun smiled slightly and said, "I really don't know about this matter. Since it is the arrangement of the Supreme Emperor, it is naturally the best for the young prince. This is Princess Rui's family matter. How can others judge it? Just feel at ease..."

For the sake of the Supreme Emperor, deities such as King Rui's widow must be offered up on boards to show that His Majesty takes good care of the Supreme Emperor's lineage.

However, since he is a god, it is fine to eat fragrant fruits and melons in free range on weekdays, but if he insists on coming down to earth to provoke people, Luoyun will never tolerate it.

Thinking of the recent times, no matter what banquet Han Linfeng attended, he would meet Princess Rui by chance. Then he heard that Princess Rui had given away her infant son. Luoyun knew that Princess Rui was trying to get back together and did not intend to socialize with her too much.

Luoyun looked at the poems they presented, selected some that were about family reunions and celebrations, and then said, "I have been feeling unwell recently and am a little tired. If you have nothing to do, please go back."

But Fang Jinshu came this time because he had something to say to Su Luoyun, so while the other ladies were kneeling down in recognition, Fang Jinshu stayed alone, saying that he still had something to say to the Crown Princess.

Luo Yun slowly took a sip of tea, looked at Fang Jinshu who suddenly knelt down and said: "Princess Rui is so nice, why did she suddenly kneel down?"

Princess Rui knelt with her waist straight, and said with a look of surrender: "I know that I have greatly offended you, Crown Princess, but you have a lot of people. Since you can greet Duke Jun and Mrs. Jun with a smile, you must be able to forgive me for my ignorance at the beginning."

Luoyun looked at her quietly and said nothing.

Fang Jinshu continued: "You haven't appeared in front of anyone for so many days, so you must have realized that the Crown Princess is not that easy to be. The Crown Prince has just ascended the throne and needs the full support of the family. But they and their son had no friendship with several famous families before, and they are in urgent need of marriage. Fortunately, Your Majesty, the palace is filled with many women from the noble families. But there is not even a concubine in the Crown Prince's house.He has worked so hard for the country, how can he be without someone who serves him well?If the Crown Princess is willing to forgive me, I am willing to serve you two as a concubine, and I will definitely let my father, as the head of the Fang family, fully support the Crown Prince. Please also put the overall situation first and consider the Crown Prince.I will definitely be grateful and support you, Crown Princess, and not let anyone come after you."

This woman with a business background wouldn't think that Han Linfeng would be like in Liangzhou in the future, without a single concubine in the house, would she?He took the initiative to surrender just to help her Su Luoyun maintain her favor.

As long as this merchant woman can calculate, she should know that she is now helpless. If she has the support of the Fang family, her life in the East Palace will be easier.

Luoyun knew that Fang Jinshu had always been unscrupulous in doing things, but he didn't expect that she would be so open-minded and could even say something about being a concubine and slave.

But she also knew Fang Er's tricks.She is the legitimate daughter of the Fang family. Even if she was married before, she was still married to a royal prince.Such a second-married noble girl is not a village widow remarrying, she must go down.

Many emperors of the previous dynasty married noble widows into the palace as concubines.

Even if Fang Jinshu was said to be a concubine, if Han Linfeng really did this, he would be humiliating the deceased Ninth Prince, throwing the face of the Supreme Emperor under his feet and trampling on him, leaving nothing but contempt for him.

So after listening to Fang Jinshu's words, Luo Yun smiled again and said calmly: "It's difficult for the ninth prince to be mourned for less than a year, and Princess Rui has to worry so much about the future of the current prince."

If her husband dies unexpectedly, even if it is just a pretense, the wife should mourn for a year before remarrying.If it had been the woman next to him, she would have been ashamed of herself because of the Crown Princess's ridicule.

But Fang Jinshu has always been different from ordinary people. After hearing this, he still held his head high and said coldly: "This man has passed away. If the spirit of the Ninth Prince in heaven knew that I was taken care of by the prince, he would definitely smile and leave with peace of mind!"

Luo Yun took another sip of tea to calm his shock, otherwise he might have seen the beating lid of the Ninth Prince's coffin.

After taking a sip of tea, Luo Yun felt that there was no need to talk to this crazy woman and said: "You are the widow of Prince Rui. Even if you have a relationship with the prince, he will not accept you. If you have nothing else to do, please come back..."
